The image is dominated by the bright yellow central disc composed of tightly packed florets and surrounded by white ray petals. Small portions of green sepals or leaves are visible peeking out from behind the petals near the center.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alikes like chamomile or aster based on fine-grained petal and disc features.
To analyze the high-frequency details of the disc florets for signs of AI 'smearing' or repetitive pattern artifacts common in generated textures.
To check for subtle edge bleeding between the white petals and the background/sepals, ensuring clean segmentation.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of the central yellow disc florets
Edge sharpness between white petals and green background
Natural variation in petal shape and spacing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the center disc. AI generators often fail to create distinct, non-repeating floret structures, resulting in a 'honeycomb' or melted wax appearance. Verify if the florets have natural irregularity. Also, check the petal bases where they meet the center for any fusion or blurring.
